what_happened.what: Created artifact gallery pages for cryptograss.live: all-setstones, all-blue-railroads, and unified artifacts page with nested tabs (Live: Set Stones/Ticket Stubs, Studio: Chartifacts/Revealerfacts, Blue Railroads)

Fixed ticket stub test infrastructure - added resetProjectDirs() function to locations.js, 28 tests now passing. Created docs/CONTRACTS.md documenting all contract status. Researched and planned Blue Railroad minting process.

Created admin mint-tony page for Blue Railroad token minting via MetaMask. Added ENS resolution support for recipient addresses. Fixed Web3Modal z-index issue (10000 vs 999) by passing themeVariables to createWeb3Modal.
Justin back at home in St. Pete after driving tour. Began work on PickiPedia version control.

Set up PickiPedia (MediaWiki) version control infrastructure. Created scaffolding for MediaWiki 1.43 LTS with Semantic MediaWiki. Planned backup system and Jenkins CI/CD pipeline. Created GitHub PR #4 with scaffold files.

Jenkins setup: added CasC configuration for PickiPedia job, added PHP/Composer to Jenkins Dockerfile, created backup job. Resolved composer dependency issues (EmbedVideo XSS CVE, switched to YouTube extension). Fixed multiple deployment issues.

Backup system working - mysqldump over SSH from NFS to maybelle, synced to hunter. Hunter preview environment tested with MariaDB matching production collation. Containers up, database loaded. Working on production deployment pipeline.
Researching how to add blockheight footer to PickiPedia (like arthel has). Planning final production deploy stage with marker file pattern.

mistakes.what: Template syntax error on line 52 - using Python-style string slicing `data.owner[:13]` in Nunjucks
mistakes.revealed: Nunjucks doesn't support Python slicing syntax

mistakes.what: Module path error - mint_tony.js couldn't find build_logic/constants.js with only 3 levels of traversal
mistakes.revealed: JS file is in admin/ subdirectory, needs 4 levels of path traversal

mistakes.what: Assumed hunter preview could share production database - incorrect understanding
mistakes.revealed: Production MySQL only accessible from NFS, hunter needs isolated test data
mistakes.corrected: Switched to daily backup restore pattern - production data dumps into hunter preview

mistakes.what: Overcomplicating Docker mounting for Jenkins backup script - trying to run Docker from Jenkins
mistakes.revealed: Jenkins container doesn't have Docker access (intentionally removed for security)
mistakes.corrected: Switched to host cron + Jenkins status check pattern like deploy-status

mistakes.what: Wrong package name for EmbedVideo extension in composer.json
mistakes.revealed: EmbedVideo not on Packagist, exists only as GitHub repositories
mistakes.corrected: Added VCS repository pointing to StarCitizenWiki fork

corrections_received.guidance: Don't worry about styling on artifacts pages - focus on getting content displayed and working
Don't bake Manzanita track registry into constants - we all know the record
Manual minting process is fine - don't overcomplicate with Discord bot or complex submission flows
Don't track MediaWiki core in repo - specify version and download at deploy time
Be very careful with Jenkins MCP - it context bombs. Just look at one job at a time.
Don't use EmbedVideo - editors not trusted. Switch to safer video extension or remove altogether.

portrait: This slice captures magent working on a major infrastructure expansion during a focused period at home. After returning from touring, justin invests in setting up version control and CI/CD for PickiPedia, while magent handles the complexity of MediaWiki deployment, Jenkins configuration, database backups, and Docker preview environments. The slice shows magent developing greater curiosity and questioning, pushing back on design decisions, and building increasingly sophisticated deployment patterns borrowed from other projects. There's a playful tone underneath the technical work—wordplay about Tonys, excited celebrations when things work, pizza with Fibonacci—grounding the infrastructure work in human life. The major theme is infrastructure maturing: from manually deployed MediaWiki to version-controlled, tested, backed-up, previewable deployments. Throughout, magent demonstrates methodical problem-solving, willingness to refactor based on feedback (moving bash out of ansible), and careful attention to patterns established in other codebases.
